messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool 'pool-east-ux' saturated. autoscaler failed to provision new nodes (error: quota_limit_reached). Queue depth rising for model:v28. Signal: sustained token-inflight increase + 95th latency spike > 3x baseline. thread created

oncall-sam: oncall here. seeing 500->429 mix? quick check: svc_ingress shows backpressure, routing to fallback not triggering.

eng-runtime-nina: digging in — v28 rollout went live ~20m ago. Early telemetry shows avg ctx length jumped from ~1.2k to ~6k for a subpopulation (long-document summarization). kv-cache entries per-session up ~5x, memory per replica climbed, batch sizes increased causing throughput regression.

sre-lee: autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts hitting project hard limit: "scale_request_rejected: reserved_capacity_quota_exceeded". Tried warm-pool > can't allocate more GPUs in region due to vendor AZ soft cap.

prod-support-jess: customer impact: a subset of high-throughput customers (ID org-78, org-122) seeing timeouts and token truncation. CS getting tickets, some customers reporting 5-10s higher P95 and intermittent 429s.

pm-ana: copying PM — we need assessment for any active canaries and whether to rollback. any immediate rollback option?

eng-runtime-nina: two options: 1) revert v28 canary to v27 (fast but rollback path needs a controlled deploy), 2) throttle long-context requests at edge with heuristic (e.g., max_context=2048) to shed load. Prefer 2 for immediate mitigation while we prepare rollback.

infra-ops-miguel: vendor reports AZ at 97% capacity for our instance types; they can’t push more right now. We can request emergency quota but ETA ~45m.

oncall-sam: immediate actions: (1) apply temporary edge throttle, (2) enable model-fallback policy to smaller quantized variant (v28-q4) for non-critical routes, (3) open vendor quota request. Assign owners: nina -> edge throttle + fallback policy, miguel -> vendor/ops, lee -> monitor autoscaler.

eng-runtime-nina: doing throttle now. Pushing config change to gateway:

```
# gateway config snippet
routes:
  - match: "/api/generate"
    max_context_tokens: 2048
    long_context_policy: reject_with_429
    fallback_model: "v28-q4"
```

eng-runtime-nina: applying... patch deployed by deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: deploy 3923456795 applied to gateway: config/gateway/edge-throttle:v1 -> success (2/3 regions active).

sre-lee: seeing immediate drop in per-replica memory allocation and batch sizes. queue depth trending down. autoscaler still blocked but queued requests reduced.

prod-support-jess: customers on org-78 reporting initial improvement for some routes. still seeing errors on heavy streams. I’ll start sending interim update to affected customers: short note + ETA for root cause.

customer-success-oliver: please include suggestion to re-run with smaller chunking and to expect degraded throughput for 30-60m. I’ll annotate CS tickets.

eng-runtime-nina: starting controlled rollback plan for canary: will stage v27 canary for 10% of traffic if edge throttle doesn’t stabilize under 10m. Rollback steps documented in ops-runbook.

oncall-sam: vendor quota request submitted by miguel — ref #VQ-8921. ETA 43m per vendor. If vendor is delayed, we should prepare to circuit-break some non-critical customers (low-tier plans) to preserve SLAs for enterprise. Assign lee to author circuit-break rule and jess to prepare customer list.

infra-ops-miguel: vendor replied: can approve extra 4 GPUs in 40-60m. No faster option unless we move region which isn’t trivial.

sre-lee: drafting circuit-break rule: throttle by org_id for top 20% of sessions by tokens_in_flight, return soft-429 + retry-after 20s. Will stage in 5m.

prod-support-jess: prepping list of affected orgs and severity tiers now. Will DM CS leads with recommended message templates.

eng-runtime-nina: telemetry after throttle: 90th token latency down ~30%, queue depth down ~60% in 6m. But some long-running streams still holding KV state; we should evict idle KV shards after 2m of inactivity to free mem. I'll push a hotpatch to kv-controller.

eng-runtime-nina: hotpatch to KV controller (evict_idle=120s) queued.

deploy-bot: deploy 3923456830 applied to kv-controller: config/kv/evict-idle:120s -> success.

sre-lee: good signal, memory reclaimed, some replicas returned to normal. Autoscaler still unable to request new GPUs but load is sustainable now with throttle + fallback.

pm-ana: decision point — hold v28 in canary and monitor, or rollback fully? data-driven recs?

eng-runtime-nina: recommended: hold canary with throttle & fallback, finish a follow-up patch to reduce KV prefetch window for v28 (will reduce average KV footprint ~35%), and schedule full rollback only if vendor quota fails. This buys time for a safe model config change.

prod-support-jess: CS will communicate that we have a mitigation in place and timeline: estimated normalization 45-90m. Will escalate to enterprise AE for org-122.

customer-success-oliver: sending personalized note to org-122 now. flagging priority.

oncall-sam: summary for incident channel: root cause = v28 rollout causing context inflation & kv-cache growth -> per-replica memory blowup -> autoscaler blocked by vendor quota -> queue growth + throttles. Mitigations: edge throttle (max_context=2048), fallback to v28-q4, kv evict idle=120s, circuit-break rule ready if vendor delayed. Owners: nina (runtime mitigations), lee (circuit-break + monitoring), miguel (vendor), jess (customer comms).

prod-support-jess: customer update posted: "We're seeing improved latency after applying mitigations. We continue to monitor and will share a full RCA after stabilizing." :thumbsup:

eng-runtime-nina: monitoring for next 60m. scheduling follow-up change to v28 model config (reduce prefetch & kv window) and a postmortem.

sre-lee: will keep paging if autoscaler errors persist. logging this incident id: INC-2026-392345.

oncall-sam: handing to daytime oncall for follow-up in 40m. handing to @oncall-day.

prod-support-jess: note for postmortem: we need automated pre-rollout checks for ctx-length distribution divergence vs baseline and a preflight that simulates kv-growth. adding to backlog.

customer-success-oliver: org-122 acknowledged and accepted interim mitigations; asking for weekly follow-up.

eng-runtime-nina: thanks team. I'll post links to traces and dashboards in follow-up message once we've got full logs correlated.

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. severity: sev2. incident created by detect/gpu-saturation at 3923456789."
